title: Russian Drone Strike on Passenger Minibus Near Nikopol Kills 5, Injures 7
detail: A Russian drone struck a scheduled passenger minibus in the Nikopol district of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast on the morning of September 16, killing five people (four men and one woman) and injuring seven others, according to Dnipropetrovsk Regional Military Administration head Oleksandr Hanzha. President Zelenskyy said the strike had "no military rationale" and called it "just another atrocity." Nikopol sits on the front line directly across the Dnipro River from the Russian-held Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and has been a recurring target of Russian drone attacks.

title: Russian UAV Strikes Industrial Facility and Energy Infrastructure in Poltava Region
detail: Russian forces launched an overnight drone assault against Poltava Oblast on September 16, striking an industrial facility in Poltava district and hitting local energy infrastructure, according to Poltava Regional Military Administration head Vitalii Diakivnych. No casualties were reported. The strike was part of a broader nationwide Russian drone campaign that night, which also damaged 17 sites in Kyiv Oblast using turbojet-powered strike drones.
